notes.text: Four storeys with nominal datums 0.00, 6.00, 9.50 and 13.00 m; roof top 16.50 m. Floor slabs are 0.25 m thick, based at each floor datum; roof base is 16.25 m. Heights are nominal floor-to-floor, not clear ceiling heights. Independent editable slabs, roof, columns, glazing panels and mullions form a simple architectural study.
